text.en: Inspector Yusuf asked to be told first.
Tell him about Didit. Send the recording.
Not yet. The police can leak too.

text.id: Pak, ada orang dari PT Bentang Pesisir, Aditya, minta HP cadangan Sekar dikirim lewat kurir. Barusan dia nelpon. Dia tahu Dinda kuliah di mana dan semester berapa.
text.en: Sir, a man from PT Bentang Pesisir, Aditya, asked for Sekar's spare phone to be sent by courier. He just called. He knows where Dinda studies and what semester she's in.

text.id: Teleponnya saya rekam. Di akhir dia bilang "demi adiknya". Sama persis kayak pesan ancaman Kamis malem.
text.en: I recorded the call. At the end he said "for her sister's sake". Exactly like the threat on Thursday night.

text.id: Anda sekarang mau jujur ke saya, Mas. Baik. Saya terima.
text.en: So now you want to be honest with me. All right. I'll take it.

text.id: Simpan rekamannya di dua tempat. Jangan kirim lewat chat. Saya ambil sendiri.
text.en: Keep the recording in two places. Don't send it over chat. I'll come for it myself.

text.id: Ancaman ke keluarga itu bisa saya kerjakan, walaupun kasus hilangnya belum. Dik Dinda jangan ke kampus dulu.
text.en: A threat against the family is something I can act on, even if the missing person case isn't yet. Dinda should stay away from campus for now.

text.id: Gue ketik, gue hapus, gue ketik lagi. Bima bilang dia kenal orang di Polda. Didit dapet nomornya dari Bima. Gue nggak tahu lagi pintu mana yang nggak bocor.
text.en: I type, delete, type again. Bima says he knows people at the regional police. Didit got this number from Bima. I don't know anymore which doors don't leak.
